name: 2N5551
description: NPN high-voltage (160V) general-purpose amplifier, the standard complement to the PNP 2N5401. Common in high-voltage small-signal stages, audio phono/tube-emulation circuits, and CRT/Nixie/EL drivers. TO-92 pinout is E-B-C (base center).

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-B-C left to right (base is the center pin). onsemi and Motorola both number 1=E, 2=B, 3=C.

typical_application: High-voltage NPN amplifier and level-shift stages needing Vceo above 100V; pairs with 2N5401 in complementary high-voltage circuits.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C (base center), the American convention
shares a datasheet with the lower-rated 2N5550 (Vceo 140V); confirm you have the 5551, not the 5550
high gain at low Ic makes it a favorite for low-noise high-voltage stages, but watch the 6V Vebo limit
